in_hindi.name: गुरुदेव
in_hindi.meaning: दातारा पंदित (Daataaraa Panditaa) = Teacher, Scholar, Guru

in_marathi.name: Gurdev
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gurdev हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Gurdev is derived from Sanskrit words ‘Guru’ meaning ‘teacher, guide’ and ‘Dev’ meaning ‘God’. This name is used to signify a person who is a spiritual guide or teacher. The name is also believed to bring prosperity and good fortune.
